title: rosa × collina f. incerta
intro: Rosa × collina f. incerta, commonly known as Fragrant Rose, is a type of fragrant rose plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its delicate, fragrant flowers and is also known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rosa × collina f. incerta include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing stress and promoting relaxation.
